latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of op0-altar skill.

- Launch and manage self-rewarding meme coins on Solana with automatic token holder payouts via the OP0 Altar protocol.
- Deploy tokens on pump.fun; holders receive rewards in one of 129 available payout tokens every few Bitcoin blocks.
- Includes actions to create an altar, check status, list altars, get altar details, and view reward token options.
- API key can be generated from within the skill using a Solana wallet address; clear error handling and guided flows.
- MCP server alternative supported for richer OpenClaw tool integration.
